acceptanceCriteria: Loaded helpers are recorded from the run (e.g. a formatter hook or $LOADED_FEATURES dump) with conventional paths only as a labelled fallback
Gemfile.lock and the described-class source files (via the autoload mapper once V1-1794 lands) are bound as freshness inputs
testplan compares retained Ruby blob ids and reports FRESH/STALE, covered by tests
body: PR #1135 (V1-1797, LPCV-V0-092/094) records helperBasis conventional-paths: blob ids of spec_helper/rails_helper/spec/support files present, not those RSpec actually loaded. Freshness inputs exclude application source under test and Gemfile.lock, so a dependency or app change leaves retained evidence looking fresh. testplan ProjectBound reports Ruby as UNKNOWN retained-blob-identity-not-compared (internal/testvaliditydoc/discover.go bindFreshness) instead of comparing blobs.
title: Ruby test provider binds conventional helper paths, not loaded helpers, and omits app source and Gemfile.lock from freshness; testplan reports Ruby UNKNOWN (residual of PR #1135)
